USER EVIDENCE
User confirms X-T20 connection succeeds. Screenshot shows camera album with
24+ entries and no thumbnails. Opening a photo and tapping retry repeatedly
returns the same placeholder. User confirms there is no specific error text.
This proves connection and partial list progress, not successful preview or
original JPEG download. The exact preview error has not yet been captured.

CHANGES
1. Metadata pages enter/leave correct-size mode once per page, rather than
   around every ObjectInfo. Nikon uses default no-op page hooks.
   Synthetic 24-photo metadata workload: 28 operations instead of120.
2. Fuji UI requests6 photos per page (10 operations for6 JPEG descriptors),
   queues that page's thumbnails before more metadata, and waits for pending
   thumbnails before auto-loading the next visible page. Non-JPEG scan bounds
   remain bounded; camera transactions remain serialized.
3. Fuji keeps a bounded in-session thumbnail cache:48 entries /8 MiB.
   Returned arrays are copied. Changed descriptions, descriptor eviction or
   changed object count invalidate cached data. Download descriptors are
   still freshly read before and after original download.
4. Grid distinguishes loading from unavailable. Failed detail preview opens
   a dialog with the actual error and an explicit retry button. Incomplete
   JPEG errors include GetThumb0x100A, received bytes, missing start/end or
   too-short information. Decode failures retain an explanation.
5. No automatic full-original fallback and no parallel PTP command stream.

LIMITATIONS
The command-count improvement is a deterministic synthetic measurement, not
an X-T20 elapsed-time benchmark. Native Android UI and actual-camera preview
were not exercised here. The user's preview failure root cause is unknown;
this build exposes the diagnostic instead of claiming a speculative fix.
If detail preview still fails, tap '查看原因' and report the actual message.
No completed real JPEG download, photo-live or RAF capability is claimed.
Previous APKs and validation records are retained. Unchanged Wi-Fi runtime
and preference suites were not rerun this round; prior records remain valid
only for their recorded scope. Existing unrelated USB fixture limitation
remains documented in the0.12.0 validation record.
